derivation.sql:
WITH ag1401 AS (
  SELECT CAST(INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT) AS iid,
         max(C_EXT_ATTR4) AS isbn13,
         max(C_EXT_ATTR9) AS parentProductId
  FROM items_ext WHERE ATTR_GROUP_ID = 1401 AND ITEM_CATALOG_GROUP_ID = 10002 GROUP BY 1
),
ag741 AS (
  SELECT CAST(INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT) AS iid,
         max(C_EXT_ATTR8) AS isbn13
  FROM items_ext WHERE ATTR_GROUP_ID = 741 AND ITEM_CATALOG_GROUP_ID <> 10002 GROUP BY 1
),
ag1164 AS (
  SELECT CAST(INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT) AS iid,
         max(C_EXT_ATTR2) AS parentIsbn13
  FROM items_ext WHERE ATTR_GROUP_ID = 1164 AND ITEM_CATALOG_GROUP_ID <> 10002 GROUP BY 1
),
isbn_owner AS (
  SELECT isbn13, min(productId) AS productId
  FROM (
    SELECT COALESCE(dig.isbn13, leg.isbn13) AS isbn13, ia.SEGMENT1 AS productId
    FROM items_all ia
    LEFT JOIN ag1401 dig ON CAST(ia.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT) = dig.iid
    LEFT JOIN ag741  leg ON CAST(ia.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT) = leg.iid
    WHERE ia.SEGMENT1 LIKE 'A%'
  ) AS owners
  WHERE isbn13 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY isbn13
)
SELECT CAST(items.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT) AS iid,
       CAST(items.ORGANIZATION_ID  AS BIGINT)  AS oid,
       COALESCE(ag1401.parentProductId, powner.productId) AS parentProductId
FROM items
LEFT JOIN ag1401 ON CAST(items.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT) = ag1401.iid
LEFT JOIN ag1164 ON CAST(items.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT) = ag1164.iid
LEFT JOIN isbn_owner powner ON ag1164.parentIsbn13 = powner.isbn13

columns.notes: Added 2026-08-17. Multi-hop on the ELSE branch — carries its own query (derivation.sql, ADR-0008: the query is the contract): 1164.C_EXT_ATTR2 is the parent's ISBN-13, which the SQL resolves to the parent's PPID via an isbn13→ppid index over ALL products (items_all + digital 1401.C_EXT_ATTR4 / legacy 741.C_EXT_ATTR8), collapsed deterministically with min(ppid) — an unordered pick would churn channel hashes every run (acceptance check A8). The digital branch is the parent PPID directly. Parent renames are a change on ANOTHER item's row and are not change-detected — refresh-columns candidate.

columns.filter: BOM_STRUCTURE_TYPES_B.STRUCTURE_TYPE_NAME = 'Pearson Standard' AND BOM_BILL_OF_MATERIALS.ALTERNATE_BOM_DESIGNATOR IS NULL AND bill on the master org (header) AND BOM_COMPONENTS_EXT_B.ATTR_GROUP_ID = 1184 (UDA rows)
columns.notes: POPULATED 2026-09-07 (UIFPE-269) from the registered bom_* Silver sources; the 2026-08-17 contract-first empty array is gone. Carries its own query (derivation.sql, ADR-0008) because it joins four tables (bill header → structure type → components → component item's SEGMENT1 via items_all, plus the UDA rows). Bills are read from the MASTER org only (99.99% of the 345,597 bills in dev; 46 sit on nine other orgs) and primary structures only (ALTERNATE_BOM_DESIGNATOR IS NULL), so one item's components are one list for every org row. Structure type by NAME ('Pearson Standard'); UDA group by id (1184) because EGO_ATTR_GROUPS_V is not in Silver. Change detection: the bill header carries ASSEMBLY_ITEM_ID (keyed source bom_bills); components / UDA rows / structure types are lookup_only, so a component-only edit lands via the daily schedule.refresh on this column (pipeline config, the price precedent). Sorted by sequenceNumber (ITEM_NUM) then ppid.

derivation.sql:
WITH master_org AS (
  SELECT min(CAST(ORGANIZATION_ID AS BIGINT)) AS oid
  FROM org_params
  WHERE CAST(ORGANIZATION_ID AS BIGINT) = CAST(MASTER_ORGANIZATION_ID AS BIGINT)
),
bom_struct AS (
  SELECT CAST(STRUCTURE_TYPE_ID AS BIGINT) AS stid,
         max(STRUCTURE_TYPE_NAME)          AS structureTypeName
  FROM bom_structure_types GROUP BY 1
),
bom_hdr AS (
  SELECT CAST(b.ASSEMBLY_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT)  AS iid,
         CAST(COALESCE(b.COMMON_BILL_SEQUENCE_ID, b.BILL_SEQUENCE_ID) AS BIGINT) AS bsid,
         s.structureTypeName                 AS structureTypeName
  FROM bom_bills b
  JOIN bom_struct s ON CAST(b.STRUCTURE_TYPE_ID AS BIGINT) = s.stid
  JOIN master_org m ON CAST(b.ORGANIZATION_ID AS BIGINT) = m.oid
  WHERE s.structureTypeName IN ('Pearson Standard', 'PEARSON_CUSTOM')
    AND b.ALTERNATE_BOM_DESIGNATOR IS NULL
),
comp_items AS (
  SELECT CAST(INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT) AS iid, max(SEGMENT1) AS componentProductId
  FROM items_all GROUP BY 1
),
bom_comp AS (
  SELECT h.iid, h.structureTypeName, h.bsid,
         CAST(c.COMPONENT_SEQUENCE_ID AS BIGINT) AS csid,
         ci.componentProductId                                 AS componentProductId,
         CAST(c.ITEM_NUM AS INT)                 AS sequenceNumber,
         CAST(c.COMPONENT_QUANTITY AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS componentQuantity,
         CAST(c.EFFECTIVITY_DATE AS DATE)        AS componentEffectiveDate,
         CAST(c.DISABLE_DATE AS DATE)            AS componentDisabledDate
  FROM bom_hdr h
  JOIN bom_components c ON CAST(c.BILL_SEQUENCE_ID AS BIGINT) = h.bsid
  JOIN comp_items ci   ON CAST(c.COMPONENT_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT) = ci.iid
),
bom_uda_std AS (
  SELECT CAST(BILL_SEQUENCE_ID AS BIGINT)      AS bsid,
         CAST(COMPONENT_SEQUENCE_ID AS BIGINT) AS csid,
         max(CAST(N_EXT_ATTR1 AS INT))         AS componentFinalPageCount,
         max(C_EXT_ATTR1)                      AS discountType,
         max(CAST(N_EXT_ATTR3 AS DECIMAL(38,2))) AS discountAmount
  FROM bom_components_ext WHERE ATTR_GROUP_ID = 1184 GROUP BY 1, 2
),
bom_uda_cust AS (
  SELECT CAST(BILL_SEQUENCE_ID AS BIGINT)      AS bsid,
         CAST(COMPONENT_SEQUENCE_ID AS BIGINT) AS csid,
         max(CAST(N_EXT_ATTR1 AS DECIMAL(38,2))) AS originalWorkPercent,
         max(CAST(N_EXT_ATTR2 AS DECIMAL(38,2))) AS customWorkPercent,
         CAST(max(D_EXT_ATTR1) AS DATE)        AS componentEffectiveDate,
         max(CAST(N_EXT_ATTR3 AS INT))         AS componentFinalPageCount,
         max(CAST(N_EXT_ATTR4 AS DECIMAL(38,2))) AS overridePercent
  FROM bom_components_ext WHERE ATTR_GROUP_ID = 1185 GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT c.iid,
       transform(
         array_sort(collect_list(named_struct(
           's1', c.sequenceNumber,
           's2', c.componentProductId,
           'p', named_struct(
             'componentProductId',              c.componentProductId,
             'sequenceNumber',    c.sequenceNumber,
             'componentQuantity', c.componentQuantity,
             'componentEffectiveDate',     c.componentEffectiveDate,
             'componentFinalPageCount',    u.componentFinalPageCount,
             'discountType',      u.discountType,
             'discountAmount',     u.discountAmount,
             'componentDisabledDate',      c.componentDisabledDate
           )))),
         x -> x.p) AS standardComponents
FROM bom_comp c
LEFT JOIN bom_uda_std u ON u.bsid = c.bsid AND u.csid = c.csid
WHERE c.structureTypeName = 'Pearson Standard'
GROUP BY 1

  SELECT CAST(b.ASSEMBLY_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT)  AS iid,
         CAST(COALESCE(b.COMMON_BILL_SEQUENCE_ID, b.BILL_SEQUENCE_ID) AS BIGINT) AS bsid,
         s.structureTypeName                 AS structureTypeName
  FROM bom_bills b
  JOIN bom_struct s ON CAST(b.STRUCTURE_TYPE_ID AS BIGINT) = s.stid
  JOIN master_org m ON CAST(b.ORGANIZATION_ID AS BIGINT) = m.oid
  WHERE s.structureTypeName IN ('Pearson Standard', 'PEARSON_CUSTOM')
    AND b.ALTERNATE_BOM_DESIGNATOR IS NULL
),
comp_items AS (
  SELECT CAST(INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT) AS iid, max(SEGMENT1) AS componentProductId
  FROM items_all GROUP BY 1
),
bom_comp AS (
  SELECT h.iid, h.structureTypeName, h.bsid,
         CAST(c.COMPONENT_SEQUENCE_ID AS BIGINT) AS csid,
         ci.componentProductId                                 AS componentProductId,
         CAST(c.ITEM_NUM AS INT)                 AS sequenceNumber,
         CAST(c.COMPONENT_QUANTITY AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS componentQuantity,
         CAST(c.EFFECTIVITY_DATE AS DATE)        AS componentEffectiveDate,
         CAST(c.DISABLE_DATE AS DATE)            AS componentDisabledDate
  FROM bom_hdr h
  JOIN bom_components c ON CAST(c.BILL_SEQUENCE_ID AS BIGINT) = h.bsid
  JOIN comp_items ci   ON CAST(c.COMPONENT_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT) = ci.iid
),
bom_uda_std AS (
  SELECT CAST(BILL_SEQUENCE_ID AS BIGINT)      AS bsid,
         CAST(COMPONENT_SEQUENCE_ID AS BIGINT) AS csid,
         max(CAST(N_EXT_ATTR1 AS INT))         AS componentFinalPageCount,
         max(C_EXT_ATTR1)                      AS discountType,
         max(CAST(N_EXT_ATTR3 AS DECIMAL(38,2))) AS discountAmount
  FROM bom_components_ext WHERE ATTR_GROUP_ID = 1184 GROUP BY 1, 2
),
bom_uda_cust AS (
  SELECT CAST(BILL_SEQUENCE_ID AS BIGINT)      AS bsid,
         CAST(COMPONENT_SEQUENCE_ID AS BIGINT) AS csid,
         max(CAST(N_EXT_ATTR1 AS DECIMAL(38,2))) AS originalWorkPercent,
         max(CAST(N_EXT_ATTR2 AS DECIMAL(38,2))) AS customWorkPercent,
         CAST(max(D_EXT_ATTR1) AS DATE)        AS componentEffectiveDate,
         max(CAST(N_EXT_ATTR3 AS INT))         AS componentFinalPageCount,
         max(CAST(N_EXT_ATTR4 AS DECIMAL(38,2))) AS overridePercent
  FROM bom_components_ext WHERE ATTR_GROUP_ID = 1185 GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT c.iid,
       transform(
         array_sort(collect_list(named_struct(
           's1', c.componentProductId,
           's2', u.componentEffectiveDate,
           'p', named_struct(
             'componentProductId',                c.componentProductId,
             'originalWorkPercent', u.originalWorkPercent,
             'customWorkPercent',   u.customWorkPercent,
             'componentEffectiveDate',       u.componentEffectiveDate,
             'componentFinalPageCount',      u.componentFinalPageCount,
             'overridePercent',  u.overridePercent,
             'componentDisabledDate',        c.componentDisabledDate
           )))),
         x -> x.p) AS customComponents
FROM bom_comp c
LEFT JOIN bom_uda_cust u ON u.bsid = c.bsid AND u.csid = c.csid
WHERE c.structureTypeName = 'PEARSON_CUSTOM'
GROUP BY 1

columns.businessDescription: Category assignments from the in-scope category sets (EPT, POA, Private Pay (POA)), with the full parent-to-mapped hierarchy path; EPT is a global catalog taxonomy auto-populated from Discipline (Levels 1-4).
columns.joinKey: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID -> item, assignment read from the master org only (fans out to all orgs)
columns.filter: MTL_CATEGORY_SETS.CATEGORY_SET_NAME IN ('EPT','POA','Private Pay (POA)') AND MTL_ITEM_CATEGORIES.ORGANIZATION_ID = MTL_PARAMETERS.MASTER_ORGANIZATION_ID

derivation.sql:
WITH cat_set_scope AS (
  SELECT CAST(CATEGORY_SET_ID AS BIGINT) AS sid,
         max(CATEGORY_SET_NAME) AS categorySetName
  FROM category_sets
  WHERE CATEGORY_SET_NAME IN ('EPT', 'POA', 'Private Pay (POA)')
  GROUP BY 1
),
master_org AS (
  SELECT min(CAST(ORGANIZATION_ID AS BIGINT)) AS oid
  FROM org_params
  WHERE CAST(ORGANIZATION_ID AS BIGINT) = CAST(MASTER_ORGANIZATION_ID AS BIGINT)
),
cat_tl AS (
  SELECT CAST(CATEGORY_ID AS BIGINT) AS cid,
         max(DESCRIPTION) AS categoryName
  FROM categories_tl WHERE LANGUAGE = 'US' GROUP BY 1
),
cat_label AS (
  SELECT CAST(c.CATEGORY_ID AS BIGINT) AS cid,
         max(c.SEGMENT1) AS categoryCode,
         max(t.categoryName) AS categoryName,
         max(c.ATTRIBUTE8) AS ecatalogIncludeIndicator,
         CAST(max(c.DISABLE_DATE) AS DATE) AS categoryDisabledDate
  FROM categories_b c
  LEFT JOIN cat_tl t ON CAST(c.CATEGORY_ID AS BIGINT) = t.cid
  GROUP BY 1
),
cat_edge AS (
  SELECT CAST(CATEGORY_SET_ID AS BIGINT) AS sid,
         CAST(CATEGORY_ID AS BIGINT) AS cid,
         max(CAST(PARENT_CATEGORY_ID AS BIGINT)) AS pid
  FROM category_valid_cats GROUP BY 1, 2
),
cat_hier AS (
  SELECT e0.sid,
         e0.cid,
         nullif(concat_ws(' > ',
                  l5.categoryName, l4.categoryName, l3.categoryName,
                  l2.categoryName, l1.categoryName, l0.categoryName), '') AS categoryHierarchyPath
  FROM cat_edge e0
  LEFT JOIN cat_edge e1 ON e1.sid = e0.sid AND e1.cid = e0.pid
  LEFT JOIN cat_edge e2 ON e2.sid = e1.sid AND e2.cid = e1.pid
  LEFT JOIN cat_edge e3 ON e3.sid = e2.sid AND e3.cid = e2.pid
  LEFT JOIN cat_edge e4 ON e4.sid = e3.sid AND e4.cid = e3.pid
  LEFT JOIN cat_edge e5 ON e5.sid = e4.sid AND e5.cid = e4.pid
  LEFT JOIN cat_label l0 ON l0.cid = e0.cid
  LEFT JOIN cat_label l1 ON l1.cid = e1.cid
  LEFT JOIN cat_label l2 ON l2.cid = e2.cid
  LEFT JOIN cat_label l3 ON l3.cid = e3.cid
  LEFT JOIN cat_label l4 ON l4.cid = e4.cid
  LEFT JOIN cat_label l5 ON l5.cid = e5.cid
)
SELECT ic.iid,
       transform(
         array_sort(collect_list(named_struct(
           's1', ic.categorySetName,
           's2', ic.cid,
           'p', named_struct(
             'categorySetName',     ic.categorySetName,
             'categoryCode',        ic.categoryCode,
             'categoryName',        ic.categoryName,
             'categoryHierarchyPath',           ic.categoryHierarchyPath,
             'categoryId',          ic.cid,
             'ecatalogIncludeIndicator', CAST(ic.ecatalogIncludeIndicator AS BOOLEAN),
             'categoryDisabledDate',         ic.categoryDisabledDate
           )))),
         x -> x.p) AS categories
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT
         CAST(a.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT) AS iid,
         s.categorySetName AS categorySetName,
         CAST(a.CATEGORY_ID AS BIGINT) AS cid,
         l.categoryCode AS categoryCode,
         l.categoryName AS categoryName,
         h.categoryHierarchyPath AS categoryHierarchyPath,
         l.ecatalogIncludeIndicator AS ecatalogIncludeIndicator,
         l.categoryDisabledDate AS categoryDisabledDate
  FROM item_categories a
  JOIN cat_set_scope s ON CAST(a.CATEGORY_SET_ID AS BIGINT) = s.sid
  JOIN master_org m ON CAST(a.ORGANIZATION_ID AS BIGINT) = m.oid
  LEFT JOIN cat_label l ON CAST(a.CATEGORY_ID AS BIGINT) = l.cid
  LEFT JOIN cat_hier h ON CAST(a.CATEGORY_SET_ID AS BIGINT) = h.sid
                      AND CAST(a.CATEGORY_ID AS BIGINT) = h.cid
) ic
GROUP BY 1

columns.notes: Added 2026-08-31 (UIFPE-232). Carries its own query (derivation.sql, ADR-0008: the query is the contract) because the column joins five tables and DERIVES hierarchy rather than reading it: the PARENT_CATEGORY_ID chain is walked from the mapped category up to the root and rendered root-first, ' > '-joined (e.g. 'Engineering > Mechanics > Aerodynamics'). SEPARATOR IS ' > ', NOT the slash the business writes: 106 of 2,944 in-scope categories (3.6%) carry a '/' inside their own label ('DC / AC Circuits', 'CAD / CAM / CIM'), so a slash separator renders paths that lie about their depth and cannot be split reliably. '>' is absent from all 132,048 US category labels in the catalog. The walk is a FIXED six-level chain because Spark has no recursive CTE; concat_ws skips nulls so one expression serves every depth. Depth MEASURED in dev 2026-08-31: max 3, zero categories at depth 4-7, so three levels of headroom — re-check if a set is added to scope, because a deeper chain loses its TOP levels quietly. Assignments are read from the master org (ORGANIZATION_ID = MASTER_ORGANIZATION_ID) and fan out to every org row, so key_mapping binds inventoryItemId ONLY. The manifest's array_sort_keys carries the full sort tuple (categorySetName, categoryId); this entry marks the primary field only, as marketingCopy does. Scope is pinned by set NAME in the mapping SQL and asserted by a test: EPT, POA and Private Pay (POA) are the business-confirmed scope for this flow (2026-08-31). Widening it is a one-line edit reviewed in a PR. The four taxonomy dimensions are lookup_only, so a category RELABEL (including isIncludeInECatalog / disableDate) is a refresh-columns candidate, not change-detected.

columns.businessDescription: Multi-row, 2-level attribute identifying which Pearson or third-party technologies underpin the item; these can include mobile, content and interactive capabilities. Held as (level 1, level 2) pairs.
columns.joinKey: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID → item (fans out to all orgs)
columns.filter: ATTR_GROUP_ID = 881 (ELSE) / 1407 (10002 Digital Catalog) — conditional by ITEM_CATALOG_GROUP_ID; rows kept when (C_EXT_ATTR1 IS NOT NULL OR C_EXT_ATTR2 IS NOT NULL)
columns.notes: Added 2026-09-07 (UIFPE-270). Conditional NESTED column: the legacy group is 881 PSON_ENABLING_TECHNOLOGY (366k rows / 354k items, up to 6 per item), the digital group 1407 PSON_PRODUCT_CAPABILITIES (15k rows / 4.9k items, avg 3, up to 11) — each SQL CTE filters both group and catalog side so the COALESCE is a strict branch pick like every other conditional. Sorted by (level1, level2), duplicates collapsed (collect_set). Rows whose both values are NULL after the null-sentinel rule (243k 'N/A / N/A' and 'TBD / TBD' rows in dev) are dropped by the declared filter.

columns.businessDescription: Link that directs customers to a product's purchase or registration page; for some product lines it must be enriched to enable purchase capabilities on Pearson's and external websites.
columns.notes: Added 2026-09-07 (UIFPE-270). PRODUCT_URL is a TL_EXT_ATTR slot, which lives in the TRANSLATIONS table EGO_MTL_SY_ITEMS_EXT_TL (US and FRC rows; US only, like longDescription) — a new manifest source, items_ext_tl. Legacy group 1165 PSON_PRODUCT_WEB_DETAILS (1.51M items in dev), digital 1406 PSON_PROD_WEB_DTLS_DGTL.

columns.joinKey: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID → item (fans out to all orgs); base and translations rows joined on EXTENSION_ID

derivation.sql:
WITH irc754 AS (
  SELECT CAST(items_ext.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AS BIGINT) AS iid,
         transform(
           array_sort(collect_list(named_struct(
             's1', CAST(items_ext.N_EXT_ATTR1 AS INT),
             's2', items_ext.C_EXT_ATTR1,
             'p', named_struct(
               'fileName',          items_ext.C_EXT_ATTR1,
               'fileExtensionCode', items_ext.C_EXT_ATTR2,
               'fileSize',          items_ext.C_EXT_ATTR3,
               'linkText',          items_ext.C_EXT_ATTR4,
               'fileUrl',           items_ext.C_EXT_ATTR5,
               'mediaFileType',     items_ext.C_EXT_ATTR6,
               'mediaStatus',       items_ext.C_EXT_ATTR7,
               'fileRankSequence',  CAST(items_ext.N_EXT_ATTR1 AS INT),
               'fileDescription',   items_ext_tl.TL_EXT_ATTR1)))),
           x -> x.p) AS instructorResourceFiles
  FROM items_ext
  LEFT JOIN items_ext_tl
         ON CAST(items_ext.EXTENSION_ID AS BIGINT)
          = CAST(items_ext_tl.EXTENSION_ID AS BIGINT)
        AND items_ext_tl.ATTR_GROUP_ID = 754
        AND items_ext_tl.LANGUAGE = 'US'
  WHERE items_ext.ATTR_GROUP_ID = 754
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT iid, instructorResourceFiles FROM irc754
